note: Hood seen from above (iso-top-right, true isometric, transparent background). Only the hood and the 4 F3 inserts are shown (Sole, boards, bonnet hidden). Insertion direction is -z: each brass insert floats 22 mm straight above its 3.6 mm blind hole in the roof top face (screen: straight down). Arrow runs from the piece label to arrow_to = pixel of the hole centre. The 4 holes are at roof (2, 3.5), (19, 3.5), (2, -26.3), (19, -26.3) mm. The larger hole left of the key hole (about 820,715) is the 4 mm battery-lead hole, not an insert hole. The hood print includes the plinth flange; the flat ledge round the hood is the hood plinth flange.
